name: Portable Disposable Soap Paper Flakes in Flower Tube Bottle | Travel-Friendly Handwashing Sheets for Outdoor & Daily Use

Stay clean anywhere with these Portable Disposable Soap Paper Flakes, packed in a stylish flower-shaped tube bottle. Just take a sheet, add water, and wash your hands effortlessly. Ideal for quick and safe hygiene on the go.Key Features:
 Soap paper flakes packed in a portable flower tube

 Lightweight, hygienic, and easy to carry

 Random color tube bottleHow to Use:
